CREATE TABLE D360.DEPO_BALANCE_ONLY
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST_ID
    ,GAM_ACID
    ,ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    ,GAM_BANK_ID
    ,GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    ,GAM_SCHM_CODE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
	,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
    ,DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
JOIN EDS.EDS_CTL CTL
ON 1 = 1
WHERE GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
	AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
	AND DEL_FLG = 'N'
	AND DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'
	AND AS_OF_DATE <= CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE
-- where ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP'
;

CREATE TABLE D360.DEPO_YTD_ALLDATES
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID)
,    HEAP
)
AS
	SELECT FULLDATE
		, Previous_Business_Day
		, Business_Day_Flag
		, DAYOFYEAR
		, LastDayOfMonth
		, Day
--		, case when month_end = 'Y' then DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) else 0 end month_end_diff
		, DATEDIFF(day, fulldate, LastDayOfMonth) month_end_diff
		, YEAR
		, MONTH
		, CUST_ID
		, GAM_ACID
		, ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
		, GAM_BANK_ID
		, GAM_SCHM_TYPE
		, MONTH_END
	FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
	JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT
		ON 1 = 1
		AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
		AND GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		AND (AS_OF_DATE = '2024-09-30' OR (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' and  AS_OF_DATE < '2024-09-30'))
	WHERE FULLDATE BETWEEN CAST ('20231229' AS DATE) AND CAST ('20240930' AS DATE);
--	WHERE FULLDATE = '2024-07-31'

--DROP TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_UAT;

CREATE TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_UAT
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID)
, PARTITION   (   [AS_OF_DATE] RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES 
				(
					'2023/12/29', '2024/02/01', '2024/03/01', '2024/04/01', '2024/05/01', '2024/06/01'
					, '2024/07/01', '2024/08/01', '2024/09/01', '2024/10/01', '2024/11/01', '2024/12/01'
					, '2025/01/01', '2025/02/01', '2025/03/01', '2025/04/01', '2025/05/01', '2025/06/01'
					, '2025/07/01', '2025/08/01', '2025/09/01', '2025/10/01', '2025/11/01', '2025/12/01'					
				) 
			)
, HEAP
)
AS
SELECT
      TMP.FULLDATE AS AS_OF_DATE
    , TMP.Previous_Business_Day
    , TMP.CUST_ID
    , TMP.GAM_ACID
    , TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE
    , TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
    , TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , (CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END) AS CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
--    , CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
--    , CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE
    , SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
        OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS TOTAL_CURRENT_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
	, COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)	AS ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
    , CAST(DAYOFYEAR AS SMALLINT) DAYOFYEAR
    , LastDayOfMonth
    , CAST(Day AS SMALLINT) Day
	, month_end_diff
    , (
--		CASE 
--			WHEN TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN 
				(
					SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
						OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) 
					+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE else 0 end
				) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
--			ELSE COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) / DAYOFYEAR
--		END
	) AS YTD_BALANCE
	
    , (
--		CASE 
--			WHEN TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN
				(
					SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
						OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
					+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP else 0 end
				) / (DAYOFYEAR + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
--			ELSE COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) / DAYOFYEAR
--		END
	) AS YTD_BALANCE_PHP
	
    , ((SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
	OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) 
	+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE) 
	/ (DAY + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
	) AS MTD_BALANCE
	
    , ((SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
	OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW )
	+ case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff * CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP else 0 end) 
	/ (DAY + case when month_end = 'Y' then month_end_diff else 0 end)
	) AS MTD_BALANCE_PHP	

    ,SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE END)
    OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE

    ,SUM(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP ELSE CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP END)
    OVER(PARTITION BY YEAR, MONTH, TMP.GAM_ACID ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP

    , TMP.MONTH_END
	, CURRENT_BD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS
FROM D360.DEPO_YTD_ALLDATES TMP
LEFT JOIN D360.DEPO_BALANCE_ONLY CURRENT_BD
    ON TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
    AND TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
	
LEFT JOIN D360.DEPO_BALANCE_ONLY CURRENT_PBD
    ON TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID 
    AND TMP.Previous_Business_Day = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
	
LEFT JOIN D360.DEP_BUSC_ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_YTD DEP_YTD
	ON TMP.GAM_ACID = DEP_YTD.ACID
	AND TMP.GAM_BANK_ID = DEP_YTD.BANK_ID
	AND TMP.FULLDATE = DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE;
